snippet.title: Study Time Anomaly | Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description:
Coming to Steam October 2025 Next Fest!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3907440/Study_Time_Anomaly?utm_source=youtube&utm_campaign=trailer2

You fell asleep studying for exams… when you woke up the school was empty. Survive the night, identify what’s wrong, and escape the loop or be stuck at school forever.

Release in November 2025

Press Kit: https://newsletter.moonmantis.gg/p/study-time-anomaly-press-kit
